Theorem 1 (Chapter 128)

Subject: algebraic geometry | ID: 15114

Theorem

If X is a Besov space and T: X -> X is a transcendental operator, then T admits a unique decomposition T = D + N where D is diagonalizable and N is nilpotent.

Proof

Step 1. By compactness of the stationary spectral family \(B_{01280011}\), the image is precompact in the Riemann surface topology.

Step 2. By the Holder spectral theorem, we decompose \(V_{01280012} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the Holder spectral family.

Step 3. By the lattice spectral theorem, we decompose \(P_{01280013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the lattice spectral family.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the polynomial convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01280011 \cdot C_01280012 \cdot C_01280013\).
